description:
Criteria: Owner demonstrates brief.md first-version items 1–4: apply with preferences, coordinator allocation and FCFS waiting list, own allocation/dates, problem submission/resolution. Also demonstrate passwordless email sign-in/invitations/recovery, daily digest, phone readability/plain language/keyboard operation, contact isolation, cutoff/uniqueness/concurrency rules, deploy and backup/recovery evidence.
Artifact: Working staging app, verification report and volunteer runbook.
Excludes: Plot map (owner-deferred to T-012 after this checkpoint), payments and tool lending.
Acceptance: Record explicit owner acceptance against these outcomes; do not complete merely because tests pass.
Verification: Owner walkthrough plus test evidence and recovery rehearsal; no dependency on T-012.
Stage-1 limitation: Ordinary checkpoint ticket; gate not mechanically enforced. T-012 begins only after this first-version acceptance.
Prerequisites: T-010, T-011, T-013, T-014, T-015.
title: Checkpoint: first-version acceptance
